test_title: PYST 118: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends (Aman, Biplab, Chirantan, Divya, Elizabeth and Firoz) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Aman sits third to the left of Biplab. Chirantan is an immediate neighbour of Aman. Elizabeth sits second to the right of Divya. Chirantan is not an immediate neighbour of Divya. Who sit between Aman and Biplab from the left of Aman?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. Aman sits third to the left of Biplab.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64ca056ad1d0a7ce1863b761bb5665ee96ac3e471570ebcba98a3fc3c39791bd.png] 

2. Chirantan is an immediate neighbour of Aman.

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eb12834835cac87430e2b97e7508bf70f4d992f6f95a3d8e3b29ed66ff12c7d.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/916d27d73eededef2e0cea16186cf02fa87c426f8d4b05be38b9f7b83273ca67.png] 

3. Elizabeth sits second to the right of Divya and Chirantan is not an immediate neighbour of Divya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a25e1a28bf9bef7c17b6e7e61cab100b3fc49e87970f748bdb730d4aa5274cb9.png] 

4. The remaining person Firoz is sitting to the left of Divya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abe407c8c696d9efa8bdcc1dfa1967b3d5345ee974f9bda7a9dd7c521bf8df34.png] 

Here, 'Chirantan and Elizabeth sit between Aman and Biplab from the left of Aman.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
